long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: Seeds that grow without permission still bother me, so I will find out what others have written about them.
The telescope is the biggest thing here and it is mine, so it goes on record.
I have still not settled the moon's colour, so I will try once more.
From a high place I can see who is coming up the beach, and I intend to be the one looking.
Dusk has come, and the sky is worth looking at through what is mine.
The green man legend is an old mystery, and I want to know who else has noticed it.

today.reason: The seeds and the moon are still open questions, so the reading and drawing come first, and the telescope waits for dusk.
